item.title: Hong Kong weighs blanket smoking ban at construction sites following deadly Tai Po fire
item.description: In the wake of the fatal Tai Po fire, the Hong Kong government has said it will seek lawmakers’ consensus on imposing a blanket smoking ban at construction sites after the new legislature is formed next month. item.title: Outgoing lawmaker Doreen Kong – seen as ‘outspoken’ in all-patriots chamber – reflects on her years in office
item.description: Meetings at the “all patriots” Legislative Council (LegCo) have ended for the term, but outgoing Hong Kong lawmaker Doreen Kong is busier than ever. item.title: Turnout in the spotlight as ‘patriots only’ polls open after deadly fire
item.description: Hong Kong will vote for new lawmakers on Sunday under Beijing’s “patriots only” rules, though government efforts to drive turnout have been overshadowed by the city’s deadliest fire in decades. Polls opened at 7:30 am across the Chinese finance hub to select 90 legislators, though only 20 of those seats are directly elected. Political campaigning […]

item.title: 71-year-old first to be arrested over ‘prejudicing’ nat. security case; warning issued over Tai Po fire mourning site
item.description: The police and national security officers have arrested a 71-year-old man in Sheung Shui for alleged sedition. The man was arrested on Saturday upon suspicion of “prejudicing of investigation of offences endangering national security” and “doing an act that has a seditious intention with a seditious intention,” a police press release said. item.title: ‘Patriots only’ poll: 4 arrests over social media comments allegedly urging election boycott or invalid ballots
item.description: The anti-graft watchdog has arrested four people for allegedly leaving comments on social media encouraging Hongkongers not to vote, or to cast an invalid ballot, in Sunday’s “patriots only” Legislative Council (LegCo) election. The Independent Commission Against Corruption (ICAC) arrested four men between 33 and 41 on election day, according to a Sunday press release. […]

item.title: Hong Kong’s ‘patriots only’ polls see 31.9% turnout – up 1.7 % on 2021, but 2nd lowest on record
item.description: Provisional turnout for Sunday’s “patriots only” Legislative Council (LegCo) stands at 31.9 per cent – up 1.7 per cent on the 2021 turnout, though still the second-lowest on record. item.title: Tai Po fire: Police oversee overnight removal of flowers, tributes from memorial by volunteers, gov’t staff
item.description: Volunteers and personnel from the Food and Hygiene Department (FEHD) have removed flowers, messages and other tributes for victims of the Tai Po fire under the watch of police officers. item.title: 40 newcomers join Hong Kong’s ‘all-patriots’ legislature, Olympic fencer Vivian Kong the youngest
item.description: A total of 40 of the 90 newly elected “all-patriots” lawmakers are first-time legislators, with retired Olympic fencing champion Vivian Kong being the youngest in the new legislature. item.title: Japan summons China ambassador over fighter jet incident
